name: Inspire Films Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Inspire Films Ltd is in the business of producing original Digital Content of various genres for Television and OTT Channels[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
IFL focuses on content creation, production, distribution, and exhibition across television and digital platforms, offering end-to-end entertainment services in collaboration with major networks. As of FY24, the company has completed 40+ projects, delivered 6,500+ episodes, created 3,000+ hours of content, and partnered with 33+ networks, including channels and OTT platforms.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.61 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.33% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 602 days to 1,327 days
